name: Pair of shoes
material: satin; silk (textile); thread; leather; embroidery silks
summary: A pair of child's shoes of the Chinese type probably acquired in the Shan States. Black satin and leather with embroidered designs of blue birds amongst foliate and floral patterns. c. 1935 to 1938.
